# JuntarHK
> Hong Kong provider of extracurricular (ECA) and experiential education programmes for schools. Serving Hong Kong kindergartens, primary and secondary schools since 2023.

JuntarHK plans and runs turnkey school ECA programmes — STEM workshops, adventure training, emerging sports, leadership training, cultural activities, ecology exploration and life-planning — with SCRC-checked instructors, full insurance and an 80,000 sq.ft. private outdoor campsite (sister company Bula Land). All programmes align with Hong Kong school funding schemes (LWLF All-round Learning Grant and QEF Quality Education Fund).

Audience: Hong Kong kindergartens, primary schools, secondary schools, NGOs and project companies.

## Topics
- STEM workshops (coding, robotics, AI thinking)
- Outdoor & adventure education (rock climbing, giant ladder, rope courses, orienteering)
- Emerging sports and team building
- Leadership training
- Chinese cultural activities and arts
- Ecology exploration
- School funding alignment (LWLF All-round Learning Grant, QEF Quality Education Fund)
